title: अलङ्कार सिद्धान्त र समसामयिक साहित्य Alankar Siddhanta ra Samasamayik Sahitya
nepali: साहित्यलाई अन्य विधाबाट अलग गर्ने तइभ्व वा विधि नै अलङ्करण विधि हो । वस्तु सत्यलाई उपस्थापन गर्दाकल्पनाको उपयोग गर्दै त्यसलाई कलात्मक वेष्टनद्वारा अप्रत्यक्षीकृत गर्ने विधि वा पद्धतिका रूपमा अलङ्कारलाईलिइन्छ । प्रत्यक्ष सत्यले इन्द्रिय वा बुद्धिलाई आह्लादित गर्छ भने आवृत सत्यले हृदयलाई प्रफुल्लित बनाउँछ ।अन्तःस्करण चतुष्ट्यरूपी द्वारबाट भित्र रहेको हृद्गुहालाई प्रकाशित गर्ने सौन्दर्य तइभ्व नै अलङ्कार हो । यही सूक्ष्मतइभ्वका रूपमा रहेको अलङ्कार सौन्दर्यलाई व्यापक दृष्टिबाट हेर्ने हो भने जुनसुकै कालमा लेखिएका र जुनसुकैविधागत सौन्दर्य अलङ्कार हुन् भन्ने कुरालाई यहाँ विभिन्न विधाका साक्ष्यबाट पुष्टि गरिएको छ । यसका निम्तिसोद्देश्यमूलक साक्ष्य छनोट गरी वर्णनात्मक विधिद्वारा व्याख्या, विश्लेषण गर्दै निष्कर्षण गरिएको छ ।
american_english: The element or method that distinguishes literature from other disciplines is none other than the method of ornamentation. Figurative ornamentation (alankara) is regarded as the method or technique of employing imagination when presenting objective truth to render it indirect through an artistic wrapping. While direct truth delights the senses or the intellect, veiled truth makes the heart rejoice. The aesthetic element that illuminates the cave of the heart from within through the gateway of the fourfold inner faculties is indeed alankara. When the ornamental beauty existing as this subtle element is viewed from a comprehensive perspective, the proposition that the aesthetic merits of any genre written in any era constitute alankara is substantiated here using evidence from various genres. Toward this end, purposive evidence was selected, and through a descriptive method, conclusions were drawn while explaining and analyzing.
british_english: The element or method distinguishing literature from other disciplines is the method of figurative ornamentation itself. Alankara (ornamentation) is taken as the method or technique of using imagination when presenting objective truth to render it non-immediate through an artistic veil. Whereas direct truth gratifies the senses or the intellect, veiled truth gladdens the heart. The aesthetic element that illuminates the inner chamber of the heart through the gateway of the fourfold inner instrument is indeed alankara. If the ornamental beauty residing as this subtle element is considered from a broad perspective, the premise that the aesthetic qualities of any genre composed in any period are alankara is substantiated here by evidence from different genres. For this purpose, purposive evidence has been selected, and conclusions have been derived through explanation and analysis employing a descriptive method.
australian_english: The element or method that sets literature apart from other fields is the method of ornamentation itself. Figurative device (alankara) is viewed as the method or practice of drawing on imagination when presenting objective truth so as to make it indirect through an artistic wrapping. Where direct truth pleases the senses or intellect, veiled truth uplifts the heart. The aesthetic element that lights up the chamber of the heart from within through the doorway of the fourfold inner mind is alankara itself. Looking at this ornamental beauty existing as a subtle element from a broad viewpoint, the idea that the aesthetic features of any genre written across any period are alankara is backed up here with evidence from various genres. To do this, purposive evidence was chosen, and conclusions were arrived at through descriptive explanation and analysis.
informal_english: The actual thing or method that sets literature apart from other fields is the whole business of figurative ornamentation. Basically, alankara is seen as the technique of using your imagination when serving up objective truth, wrapping it in an artistic layer so it isn't just blunt and literal. While naked truth pleases the senses or the brain, truth that’s veiled like this really warms the heart. The aesthetic spark that lights up the inner depths of your heart right through the fourfold mental faculties is alankara itself. If you take a step back and look at this subtle beauty from a wider angle, the point that aesthetic flair in any genre from any time period counts as alankara is backed up here with proof from different genres. To get that done, purposeful examples were picked out, and using a descriptive approach, conclusions were drawn through straightforward explanation and analysis.
translator_notes: The source text exhibits the OCR artifact 'तइभ्व' for 'तत्त्व' (element). Traditional Sanskrit poetic and philosophical concepts such as 'अलङ्कार' (alankara / figurative ornamentation) and 'अन्तःस्करण चतुष्टय' (the fourfold inner instrument: mind, intellect, memory/consciousness, ego) are translated systematically across all 6 sentences.
